WITH RECURSIVE CategoryPath AS (
    SELECT id, name, parent_id, 1 AS depth
    FROM categories
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, cp.depth + 1
    FROM categories c
    INNER JOIN CategoryPath cp ON c.parent_id = cp.id
)
SELECT * FROM CategoryPath ORDER BY depth, name;

SELECT 
    employee_id,
    department_id,
    salary,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank_in_dept,
    AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY department_id) AS dept_avg_salary
FROM employees;

INSERT INTO user_preferences (user_id, theme, updated_at)
VALUES (42, 'dark', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
SET theme = EXCLUDED.theme, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

SELECT 
    date_trunc('month', created_at) AS order_month,
    COUNT(id) AS total_orders,
    COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0.00) AS total_revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC;

SELECT p.id, p.title
FROM posts p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM comments c 
    WHERE c.post_id = p.id 
    AND c.is_flagged = FALSE
);
source: SQL 1k: Efficient Correlated Subquery with EXISTS

CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_user_created 
ON user_sessions (user_id, created_at DESC);

SELECT 
    id,
    amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
FROM transactions;
source: SQL 1k: Cumulative Running Total Window Frame

SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM articles, json_each(articles.tags)
GROUP BY tag
HAVING count > 5
ORDER BY count DESC;
